text:
amy: FYI started a short gated promote for v12-lite (int4) at 11:45 PT. 0.5% traffic to check long-context behavior.
ben: ok. any initial flags?
amy: early signal: long-doc summarization slice showing -2.2% MRR vs v11 (n=720). latency p50 +8ms, cost ~-18%.
dalia: 0.5% is small. but we treat long-doc as high-sensitivity. what's our manual threshold?
amy: current rule is 1.5% absolute MRR drop -> hold. so this triggers.
ricardo: hold the ramp. deploy-bot please revert the promotion.
deploy-bot: rollback issued by eng-ml user=amy rollback_id=rb_2026_1739900000
ci-bot: Canary alert PG-1739900000: long_doc slice breach detected.
ben: next steps: 1) run a 50k shadow job with exact batching to reproduce; 2) gather token divergence and stop-token frequency; 3) capture top 20 output diffs.
dalia: add experiment: int4 + fp16-KV (runtime flag) to see if KV quant path is the culprit.
amy: +1. also log HTML-heavy inputs separately; we saw encoding variance in past runs.
ricardo: can we add a PhaseGate tweak: per-slice min_n requirement (min_n_long=2k) and an adjustable weight for long-docs? That would avoid tiny-n false positives.
ben: yes. draft config: {"slices.weighted": "true", "slices.long_doc.weight": "2", "slices.long_doc.min_n": "2000", "auto_fallback": "true", "cooldown_min": "10"} — will PR.
dalia: ensure weight normalization in scoring math and add note that min_n is required before auto-promotion completes.
amy: I'll open the incident note and queue the shadow runs. tagging @dalia for tokenization checks.
dalia: on it. will run tokenization diff and generate a short report.
ben: plan to reconvene once shadows finish (~3h). hold promotes until then.
amy: thanks folks. reminder: cost wins are nice but not at the expense of summary quality. :thumbsup:
